questions.stem: 受暴利吸引，盜獵者（poachers）大量捕捉穿山甲（pangolins），而穿山甲的數量在過去二十年已大幅減少。
questions.answer: Attracted by huge profits, poachers catch large numbers of pangolins, whose population has declined sharply over the past twenty years.
accepted_answers: Driven by enormous profits, poachers capture a great many pangolins, whose numbers have dropped dramatically in the past two decades.
Lured by huge profits, poachers hunt huge numbers of pangolins, whose population has been greatly reduced over the last 20 years.

questions.stem: 他們捕捉的穿山甲（pangolins）大多被賣到海外市場，因為許多人相信牠們的鱗片能治病。
questions.answer: Most of the pangolins they catch are sold to overseas markets, because many people believe that their scales can cure diseases.
accepted_answers: The pangolins that they catch are mostly sold to markets abroad, as many people believe their scales can cure illnesses.
Most of the pangolins which they capture are sold to foreign markets because many people believe that pangolin scales can treat diseases.

1.explanation_zh: 「受暴利吸引」的主詞就是後面的盜獵者，盜獵者是「被」吸引，用過去分詞構句 Attracted／Lured by huge profits, poachers …（「暴利」是 huge profits，不要直譯成 violent profits）。「大量捕捉」是 catch large numbers of …，可數名詞用 numbers。「而穿山甲的數量…」補充說明前面的 pangolins，用非限定關係子句 whose population …（表所有關係用 whose，前面要有逗號）；「在過去二十年已大幅減少」從過去持續到現在，用現在完成式 has declined sharply over the past twenty years。
evidence: 而穿山甲的數量在過去二十年已大幅減少
1.strategy_zh: 句首「受…」而主詞在後面時想過去分詞構句；後半「而＋前面的名詞…」補充說明時想 , which／whose …。
hints: 切成四段：受暴利吸引／盜獵者大量捕捉穿山甲／而穿山甲的數量／在過去二十年已大幅減少
標的詞彙：attract（吸引）、huge（巨大的）、profit（利潤）、catch（捕捉）、large numbers（大量）、population（數量）、decline（減少）、sharply（大幅地）、past（過去的）、year（年）
句型框架：p.p. + by …, S + V + N, whose + N + has p.p. + adv. + over the past …

2.explanation_zh: 「他們捕捉的穿山甲」修飾語在前，英文用受格關係子句後位修飾：the pangolins (that) they catch，that 可省略；「大多」可寫 Most of the pangolins …（most of 後面要有 the）。「被賣到海外市場」用被動 are sold to overseas markets。「因為許多人相信…」接完整子句，用 because many people believe (that) …；「牠們的鱗片能治病」是 their scales can cure diseases，sick 是形容詞，不能當 cure 的受詞。
evidence: 他們捕捉的穿山甲（pangolins）大多
2.strategy_zh: 「……的＋名詞」先找修飾語裡有沒有自己的主詞（他們），有就用受格關係子句；看到「被…」用 be + p.p.。
hints: 切成四段：他們捕捉的穿山甲大多／被賣到海外市場／因為許多人相信／牠們的鱗片能治病
標的詞彙：catch（捕捉）、most（大多）、sell（賣）、overseas（海外的）、market（市場）、believe（相信）、scale（鱗片）、cure（治療）、disease（疾病）
句型框架：Most of the + N + (that) + S + V + are sold to …, because + S + believe (that) …

traps.explanation_zh: 「暴利」指極高的利潤 huge／enormous profits；照字面把「暴」譯成 violent 意思就錯了。

traps.literal_error: …, whose population declined sharply in the past twenty years.

bonus.text: So lucrative is the pangolin trade that poachers keep hunting these animals, whose population has plummeted over the past two decades.
bonus.explanation_zh: So + 形容詞置首倒裝（So lucrative is …）強調利潤之高，plummet（暴跌）比 decline 更生動。屬加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

1.restructuring_zh: 「受暴利吸引」省略的主詞就是後面的盜獵者，用過去分詞構句 Attracted by huge profits, …；「而穿山甲的數量…」不另起一句，英文用 whose 接在 pangolins 後面補充說明；「在過去二十年已…」用現在完成式 has declined。
1.notes_zh: 第 3 部分寫成 , the population of which has … 也算非限定關係子句。寫成 , and their population has … 是對等子句，文法正確但沒有用到標的句型，不在可接受寫法內。第 1 部分寫成 Because they are attracted by … 是副詞子句，沒有用到分詞構句，不在可接受寫法內。第 3 部分寫 whose numbers 時，第 4 部分的助動詞用 have。

2.notes_zh: 第 1 部分也可以寫 The pangolins (that) they catch are mostly …（這時第 2 部分從 sold to … 開始）。只寫 The pangolins they catch are sold … 漏譯「大多」，第 1 部分不給分。寫成分詞片語 the pangolins caught by them 沒有用到標的關係子句，不在可接受寫法內。「海外市場」寫 overseas markets、foreign markets、markets abroad，或簡寫成 are sold overseas 都可以。

1.translation: Lured by huge profits, poachers have captured pangolins in large numbers, and their population has dropped sharply over the past two decades.

2.translation: Most of the pangolins they catch are sold to overseas markets because many people believe that their scales can cure diseases.
2.explanation_zh: 「他們捕捉的穿山甲」用省略關係代名詞的關係子句 the pangolins (that) they catch；「大多被賣到」用 Most of ... are sold to；「因為許多人相信」用 because many people believe that ...；「能治病」用 can cure diseases。

issues_zh: 中文「，而穿山甲的數量……」的「而」是並列／承接連接詞，盲譯很自然地寫成 , and their population has dropped（對等子句），沒有引出標的句型 NRREL（, whose population has …）；第 3 部分 accepted 只有 whose population／whose numbers／the population of which 等六種，並列寫法一律不給分，學生無法從中文看出要用非限定關係子句，所以我的譯文只用到 PART（Lured by huge profits）。

第 2 部分 accepted 只列一般現在式 poachers catch／capture／hunt …，沒有現在完成式（have captured）或句尾的 in large numbers；中文後半句說「過去二十年已大幅減少」，前半句用現在完成式同樣自然，我的 have captured pangolins in large numbers 因此落在 accepted 之外（within_accepted 為 false）。
建議：把標的句型換成中文本來就會引出的寫法，或把中文改成能帶出關係子句的說法（例如「……大量捕捉穿山甲，其數量在過去二十年已大幅減少」，用「其」對應 whose）；同時放寬第 2 部分的時態與 in large numbers 句尾副詞片語。參考譯文本身沒有錯誤。
